question: What is the name of the disease that can be caused by Vitamin D deficiency in children?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rickets**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rickets is a skeletal disorder that results from a deficiency of vitamin D, calcium, or phosphate.
 
• It leads to softening and weakening of the bones in children, potentially causing bone deformities.
 
• Common symptoms include delayed growth, pain in the spine, pelvis, and legs, and muscle weakness.
 
• Rickets can lead to skeletal deformities such as bowed legs or thickened wrists and ankles.
 
• The disease can be prevented by ensuring adequate intake of vitamin D, calcium, and phosphate through diet and sunlight exposure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vitamin D**

 
 
• Vitamin D is crucial for the absorption of calcium and phosphate in the body.
 
• It can be obtained through dietary sources such as fatty fish, fortified dairy products, and supplements.
 
• Sunlight exposure also triggers vitamin D synthesis in the skin.
 
 
 
• **Calcium**
 
 
• Calcium is essential for the development and maintenance of strong bones and teeth.
 
• Dairy products, leafy green vegetables, and fortified foods are good sources of calcium.
 
 
 
• **Phosphate**
 
 
• Phosphate plays a key role in bone formation and energy storage and release.
 
• It is found in foods such as meat, fish, dairy products, and whole grains.
 
 
 
• **Prevention and Treatment**
 
 
• Ensuring a balanced diet with adequate vitamin D, calcium, and phosphate is crucial for preventing rickets.
 
• Supplementation may be necessary in cases of deficiency or limited sun exposure.
 
• Medical treatment for rickets may include high doses of vitamin D and calcium supplements.
 
• In severe cases, corrective surgery may be required for bone deformities.
